methodology.name: event_source

methodology.name: causal_computation
methodology.value: per-window truncation at the window end
methodology.note: every value equals Ava's pipeline run on frames [0, end) of the session: frames at or after the window end have no influence on any value (a pre-event window: none at or after onset - gap). They are read: the pipeline runs once on the whole session and its values are reused only where they provably equal the truncated run (else it is rerun on [0, end)); annotations after the window are read by the exclusion rules

methodology.name: tracking_flags
methodology.value: flag_tracking: frame 1024x570, min_score 0.15, frozen 15 frames, jump detection off
methodology.note: jump limit not chosen (Ava's decision); single-frame keypoint collapses pass every flag

methodology.name: score_validation
methodology.note: a present keypoint with a missing (null / NaN), infinite or out-of-range score is low_conf for that frame (not tracking_ok); its confidence is never assumed

methodology.name: tracking_ok
methodology.value: every torso keypoint of both mice passes the flags
methodology.note: torso = neck, left_hip, right_hip (team decision); not motion accuracy

methodology.name: interpolation
methodology.note: interpolate_short_gaps is two-sided and is never applied

methodology.name: smoothing
methodology.note: features.FeatureParams default {'min_cutoff': 1.0, 'beta': 0.0}; causal; run from frame 0 and NOT restarted at the window or its history start (only after a gap longer than the filter's max_gap_s), so frames before the history start keep a decaying influence

methodology.name: smoother_memory_frames
methodology.note: valid samples after which all older inputs together weigh < 0.01 in a smoothed position (bound at the minimum cutoff); a provisional margin that sets the history start used by the exclusion rules, not a bound on the nonlinear features

methodology.name: fps
methodology.note: calms21.FPS

methodology.name: pre_event_window
methodology.note: onset = the episode's first annotated frame; clipped to frame 0 and excluded (starts_before_session) if it would start earlier

methodology.name: feature_lookback_frames
methodology.note: largest lookback of the requested features (dist_rate 1)

methodology.name: history_start
methodology.value: start - lookback, then back over smoother_memory_frames + 1 valid body-centre samples of each mouse
methodology.note: used only by the exclusion rules; earlier frames are still read and together weigh < 1% in each smoothed position of the window (missing samples extend it)

methodology.name: event_overlap_rule
methodology.note: pre-event windows whose window, feature history or gap contains any frame annotated with the behavior (any episode of the session) are excluded as overlaps_event

methodology.name: usable_frame
methodology.value: finite value and tracking_ok at t-1 and t
methodology.note: both derivative endpoints; the same rule as Stage 1 history H = 1

methodology.name: min_usable_fraction

limitations: SYNTHETIC test fixture: not CalMS21 data, not evidence.
Session-level comparison: windows and frames are not independent replicates; the effect is the median of per-session paired differences, so its precision is set by the number of paired sessions.

No p-value, significance or confidence interval is reported: the effect is the median of the available paired session differences, a description of these sessions, not a population estimate. No session-level uncertainty method has been approved.

Investigation confound (not resolved): windows before an attack are mostly annotated 'investigation', baselines mostly 'other' (label_frames_* in methodology); a difference may reflect investigation versus other behavior, not 'before attack'.
Session-timing confound (not resolved): pre-event windows and baseline tiles can lie at different times of the session (window_start_s_* in methodology); activity may drift within a session.
Missing tracking: windows below min_usable_fraction are excluded and usable frames are not interpolated; if tracking loss is related to behavior, the remaining frames are a biased sample.
Pixel scale: distances and rates are in image pixels, not calibrated between sessions; session differences from different camera geometries are pooled as they are.

Motion accuracy is not verified: tracking_ok only means the keypoints passed the quality flags. One-frame keypoint collapses that pass every flag exist in these sessions (Stage 1 report, section 4); the smoother carries them for tens of frames. No jump limit has been chosen.
dist_rate < 0 means the body-centre distance is decreasing; it does not say which mouse moved or that either approached. CalMS21 Task 1 has no 'approach' label. Association, not causation.
Baseline clearance from the behavior is the caller's selection (get_window_features); this tool re-checks only clearance 0: no behavior frame in a baseline tile or its feature history.
Window length, gap, min_usable_fraction, smoother-memory margin and sufficiency criteria are provisional choices, not validated settings.
Behavior frames are human annotations (annotator 1) of CalMS21 Task 1 validation sessions; boundaries are uncertain. Held-out test annotations are never read.
